instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Croatian tweet convey, judged from its tone and from the valence of what it reports or shares?
instructions.rule: Negative needs the poster to be bothered or attacking: their own complaint, mishap or suffering (even joked about), annoyance, targeted sarcasm, moralising, or news of something bad (crisis, conflict, criticism, accusation, lawsuit, death, scandal). Replies that mainly give information, logistics, questions or opinions are neutral even with a smiley, as are statistics, deadpan observations, political events, religious texts and horoscopes. Friendly replies (invitations, agreement, encouragement, greetings, cheering, playful laughter) and shares of culture, entertainment, tech, business deals, teasers, tips, ads, check-ins and help appeals are positive.

neutral.what: Replies giving information, logistics, plain questions or opinions. Statistics, dividends, line-ups. Political or institutional events. Religious texts, horoscopes. Deadpan observations about others.
examples: @ewanblaskowicz Nema na čemu. :) Mijenjaš u Postavkama (a gdje drugdje), jezik+regija, promijeniš 'Država/regija' u što hoćeš i restart . (You're welcome :) You change it in Settings, language+region, then restart.)

Mama gleda njemačku Bachelorette. Žena gleda američki Masterchef. Počinjem štedjet za treći televizor. (Mom watches German Bachelorette. My wife watches American Masterchef. I'm starting to save for a third TV.)
Ne propustite večeras debatu kandidata za predsjednika @EU_Commission @hrtvijesti http://t.co/EgGMQ2dir7 (Don't miss tonight's debate of candidates for Commission president)
neutral.cues: sabor (parliament), debata (debate), dividenda (dividend), horoskop, numbers, instructions, 'mislim da' (I think)
neutral.not_for: The poster's own annoyance or mishap, or bad news, go negative. Friendly or cheering replies and promotional shares go positive.

positive.what: Joy, praise, thanks, warmth, cheering, greetings, invitations, encouragement. Shares of events, culture, celebrities, tech, business deals, article teasers, recipes, ads, check-ins, help appeals.
examples: Pula: Na Giardinima započela 8. Florija, sajam cvijeća u sklopu obilježavanja Dana Grada: https://t.co/6Jbezcjeer (Pula: the 8th Florija flower fair started at Giardini)
@Kjukar   Ako bude kakve srece, popit cemo kavu negdje ovih dana (If we're lucky, we'll have coffee one of these days)
@sasabca Bit će bolje, mora :) (It will get better, it has to :))
positive.cues: festival, ponuda (offer), pročitajte (read), pitanje za milijun dolara (million-dollar question), pomozimo (let's help), hvala (thanks), u pravu si (you're right), ajmo (let's go), dobar dan (good day), :D
positive.not_for: Smileys on complaints or digs go negative. Informational or logistical replies with a smiley go neutral.

negative.what: The poster complains, suffers a mishap, is annoyed, sad or worried, insults, mocks or moralises. Also news of bad things: crises, debt, conflicts, harsh criticism, accusations, lawsuits, deaths, mourning, scandals.
examples: Naravno, opet kiša u Brusselsu. (Of course, rain in Brussels again.)
Putin na presici žestoko kritizira novo ukrajinsko vodstvo: 'Vojna akcija protiv Ukrajine će biti posljednja opcija!' (Putin harshly criticizes the new Ukrainian leadership)
@LucijaCavric oho i ovdje si finjak :P (oho, you're being posh here too)
negative.cues: opet (again), jebiga (damn it), mrzim (I hate), sranje (crap), grozan (awful), kritizira (criticizes), žalost (mourning), dug (debt), :(, :S
negative.not_for: Help appeals go positive. Witty observations about others and calm opinions go neutral.
